items.title: Motor racing-Hamilton says 'heart sank' as tyre gamble backfired before stunning Sepang recovery
items.summary: Read more about Motor racing-Hamilton says 'heart sank' as tyre gamble backfired before stunning Sepang recovery on Devdiscourse ...
items.body:
Motor racing-Hamilton says 'heart sank' as tyre gamble backfired before stunning Sepang recovery
Reuters | Updated: 04-10-2026 17:32 IST | Created: 04-10-2026 17:32 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Lewis Hamilton said he had mixed emotions after the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia where he started second on the grid but dropped to 18th when a tyre gamble went wrong before fighting to finish third in a chaotic, rain-hit race on Sunday.
After rain delayed the start of the race by more than 90 minutes, Hamilton was one of the few drivers who switched from intermediate tyres to slicks on a track that was still drying. The Briton had a slow start and then found himself going backwards, falling as low as 18th, but he opted to stick with his strategy despite Ferrari calling him back into the pits for a tyre change.
Hamilton then carved his way through the field as the track dried up while safety cars also came to his rescue, with the veteran eventually overtaking Red Bull's Isack Hadjar in the dying stages to secure a podium behind Max Verstappen and Kimi Antonelli. "As a team, we ended up taking that soft (tyre) and at the end of the pit lane, these two (Verstappen and Antonelli) took off their (tyre) blankets and my heart just sank, because I knew straight away that we were in trouble," Hamilton told reporters.
"As we pulled out, all the spray came out the back of Max's car and I was like, 'Okay, I'm done. My race is really in trouble'. "We made the decision to live with it. As everyone was overtaking me, they (Ferrari) said, 'Should we stop?' I said, 'No, we've already waited another 26 seconds. What's the difference'."
But as the track dried and safety car deployments played into his hands, Hamilton began a remarkable recovery drive as he gave Hadjar chase for fourth place, before George Russell's retirement gave him a shot at a podium. "I just waited for the track to dry and once it did, it felt good that I was catching people. The car felt great. Then after that, really good pit stops from my guys in the garage," Hamilton added.
"And then a good strategy. So for us to get back to the podium, I never thought that that's what was going to be the case. I'm really, really grateful." His teammate Charles Leclerc also salvaged fourth place for Ferrari and he conceded that was the best they could have achieved considering how much faster Red Bull and Mercedes were.
"Honestly, the first part of the race, everything that could have gone wrong went wrong. And on the second part, everything that could have gone right went our way," Leclerc said. "So at the end of the day, I prefer it that way than the other way around. We were P4 today and I honestly think that with a normal race we would have finished P3 and P4. The two guys in front were just way too quick for us.
"Lewis had quite a good pace. I struggled a lot with the car, which we're looking into. I had a good feeling on Friday, good feeling until Q2, and then Q3 I started to lose out. Today the race was very tricky."

items.title: Leftist and nationalists lead in election for Bosnia's tripartite presidency
items.author: Branko Filipovic, Fedja Grulovic
items.creator: Branko Filipovic, Fedja Grulovic
items.summary: Voters are casting ballots for the central tripartite presidency and national parliament.
items.body:
A Bosniak left-leaning moderate, a pro-Russian Serb nationalist and a Croatian nationalist are leading Sunday's election for Bosnia's inter-ethnic tripartite presidency, the election commission said, based on ballots from more than 90% of polling stations.
The results were largely in line with expectations and with projections by the Poliwave tracking platform, although voter turnout was low at a combined 42.2% in Bosnia's two entities, the Bosniak-Croat Federation and the Serb Republika Srpska. Voters also cast ballots for the national parliament, alongside regional races in the two entities.
Voter frustration has grown over an economic slowdown, the slow pace of EU entry talks and a lingering political crisis in which ethnically based dominant parties from the two entities have repeatedly stalled decisions by the weak central government that links them.
Denis Becirovic, a Bosniak of the Social Democratic Party (SDP-BiH) and part of the current tripartite presidency, garnered 26.66% of votes in the Bosniak-Croat Federation, ahead of the candidate for the centrist and traditionalist Bosniak Muslim Party of Democratic Action (SDA). The two had been considered close favourites in the election.
Also leading in the Bosniak-Croat Federation was newcomer Darijana Filipovic of the nationalist and pro-European Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ-BiH), with 14% of the vote.
In Republika Srpska, Zeljka Cvijanovic, an existing member of the tripartite presidency from the Serb and pro-Russian nationalist Alliance of Independent Social Democrats (SNSD), secured 55.34% of votes, the election commission said.
Voting continued in some polling stations after the 7 p.m. (1700 GMT) deadline due to delays related to a new electronic balloting system, Bosnia's Central Election Commission head Jovan Kalaba told reporters in Sarajevo.
The election commission redesigned ballots and introduced new biometric voter identification and electronic scanners, which it said were aimed at curbing voting fraud.
Speaking in Banja Luka, the largest Bosnian Serb city, Milorad Dodik, a separatist and pro-Russian leader of the SNSD who visited Moscow and met Russian President Vladimir Putin last week, said his party's candidate Savo Minic won the most votes for president of the Republika Srpska entity.
"We have won the member of the (Bosnian) Presidency, and the president of the Republika Srpska. An unexpectedly high result," Dodik said.
Since the Bosnian war ended in 1995 under the US-brokered Dayton peace accord, the country has been split along ethnic lines into two entities linked by the weak central government and tripartite presidency.
Bosnia, which has struggled to recover from the 1992-95 war, secured EU candidate status in December 2022 and approval to open accession negotiations in 2024. Actual talks have not started, however, because the domestic legislatures have yet to enact core requirements such as bolstering judicial oversight and passing anti-corruption laws.
Borjana Kristo, the deputy-head of the Croat HDZ-BiH, said that overall progress could be made through dialogue after the elections.
"Bosnia must make progress solely on the principle of consensus, dialogue, and mutual respect," she told party supporters, cautioning against rhetoric that would drag the country backwards.
Many voters in the country of 3.4 million people say they want to move beyond divisive rhetoric but its politics have become deadlocked.
The EU and Russia have been vying for influence over Bosnia, with the EU seeking to expand its membership across the Balkans while Russia wants to slow that process down and preserve its influence over the Republika Srpska.
The US has also sought to bolster its influence in Bosnia, pushing for a $1.5 billion [USN:L6N40Y0SF TEXT:"pipeline project"] to import US liquefied natural gas. The EU has said, however, that the selection of the company for the project lacked competitive transparency, while Washington and Brussels have also clashed over the role of the [USN:L6N41N07W TEXT:"High Representative"], the international peace overseer for the country.

items.summary: Australian police said on Sunday that authorities there were investigating the "links to Australia" of a flydubai co-pilot who attacked the captain on a flight to Tel Aviv. The co-pilot of the ...
items.body:
Australia probes flydubai co-pilot links, police say
Reuters | Updated: 04-10-2026 17:28 IST | Created: 04-10-2026 17:28 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Australian police said on Sunday that authorities there were investigating the "links to Australia" of a flydubai co-pilot who attacked the captain on a flight to Tel Aviv. The co-pilot of the flydubai flight 1073, which was bound for Israel from Dubai, attacked the pilot with an emergency crash axe, the United Arab Emirates prosecutor general said on Saturday, calling the incident a "terrorist attack".
The co-pilot of the flydubai jet was identified as Hammam al-Hammami, an Omani national, two sources with knowledge of the investigation told Reuters. UAE authorities did not immediately respond to a request for confirmation of his identity. Reuters could not independently reach al-Hammami for comment. Omani authorities have not commented. Flydubai has said a full investigation is under way.
Two sources briefed on the investigation said the co-pilot studied at a university in Melbourne, capital of the Australian state of Victoria. Local media reports said he studied at RMIT university. RMIT told Reuters it had no comment. "The Victorian Joint Counter Terrorism Team (VIC JCTT), comprising the AFP, Victoria Police and ASIO, can confirm it is investigating the man's links to Australia. An update will be provided at an appropriate time," an Australian Federal Police (AFP) spokesperson said, referring to the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation.
The Financial Times reported on Sunday that al-Hammami had allegedly visited radical mosques and extremist websites while in Australia, citing two people familiar with the investigation. Australian intelligence services held a file on the individual, according to the FT.
Reuters could not immediately verify the FT report. The government of Australia did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside business hours.

items.title: Merz unveils fresh military aid in Kyiv, says Germany won't be intimidated
items.author: Andreas Rinke, Felix Hoske
items.creator: Andreas Rinke, Felix Hoske
items.summary: Germany's chancellor said Moscow was trying to break the morale of the Ukrainian people, and announced €350 million for repairs in the energy sector.
items.body:
Germany will not be intimidated into dropping its support for Ukraine, Chancellor Friedrich Merz said on Sunday as he announced a further €1 billion ($1.1 billion) in military aid during a visit to Kyiv marked by Russian drone attacks.
Air-raid sirens and explosions rang out repeatedly across the Ukrainian capital as Merz and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy visited a memorial to soldiers killed during the four-year-old war, as well as the [USN:L1N45K0A2 TEXT:"Academy of Sciences"], where at least two people died in a drone strike last week.
Russia has escalated its drone attacks on Kyiv and other cities in recent weeks, targeting telecoms, electricity and transport infrastructure as well as military assets.
Speaking at a press conference alongside Zelenskiy, Merz said Moscow was trying to break the morale of the Ukrainian people, and announced €350 million for repairs in the energy sector. He said Germany remained Ukraine's strongest backer.
DEALS WITH GERMAN COMPANIES WORTH €6.6 BILLION "We do this not only to protect Ukraine's territorial integrity; we do it deeply in our own interest, for it is a matter of Europe's security," Merz said, noting that Russia was carrying out cyberattacks and disinformation campaigns that struck at Europe's democratic order.
"This demonstrates that we will not be intimidated," he said.
Russia has said accusations of hybrid warfare are baseless and the result of anti-Russian hysteria.
German officials said executives from companies, who travelled with Merz, had signed 14 agreements with the Ukrainian government and businesses worth roughly €6.6 billion.
Among those deals, Ukraine inked an agreement with Germany's Diehl Defence for the supply of IRIS-T air defence missiles, as well as a deal for radar equipment with Hensoldt and for jet drone interceptors with Quantum Systems.
"What is important in this visit is that not only Germany is helping Ukraine, but Ukraine is sharing its knowledge, experience, as well as orders," Zelenskiy said. "These are jobs for Germany."
Zelenskiy praised a new jet drone interceptor, dubbed SPYS and developed by Quantum, for showing promising results. He said Ukraine and Germany were close to [USN:L1N44U0N8 TEXT:"finalising a broad defence deal"], which he has previously said would include the production of drones, missiles and related software.
ZELENSKIY VOWS TO RESPOND Since the summer, Russia has targeted civilian and military infrastructure daily with dozens of high-speed jet-powered [USN:L8N4521KI TEXT:"attack drones"] – which Ukraine has struggled to down because they are much faster than previous propeller versions.
One of the Russian strikes on Sunday hit the Northern Bridge across the Dnipro River, damaging its roadway, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram. The explosion injured two people and damaged a hot water supply system in the area, he said.
Zelenskiy said Russia's decision to escalate air strikes against infrastructure targets was due to setbacks it had suffered on the battlefield, and he vowed that Ukraine would retaliate. He said Russian President Vladimir Putin wanted to force residents to flee Ukraine's major cities.
"If our bridges collapse, we will manage to get out of this situation, but his people will feel it too ... This is maximum escalation of this war," Zelenskiy told reporters.
Russia has been [USN:L1N45P00Z TEXT:"attacking"] Kyiv's bridges since last week in an effort to disrupt links between the capital's two sides and logistics routes between central and eastern Ukraine.
MERZ APPEALS FOR END TO 'SENSELESS WAR' Zelenskiy said US peace envoy Steve Witkoff has messaged him to urge a return to trilateral talks as soon as possible. He said Ukraine was willing to meet this month and hoped Russia would join, but he said Western allies needed to apply more pressure to Moscow to bring the war to an end.
Earlier in the day, during the visit to the badly damaged Academy of Sciences, Merz appealed to Putin to "put an end to this senseless war".
"We are ready for talks, we are ready to discuss bringing this war to an end, but these barbaric attacks on the civilian population of Ukraine must stop," the German leader said.
Russia's Foreign Ministry [USN:L1N45P03K TEXT:"said"] on Saturday that Moscow would continue to systematically hit targets in Ukraine in what it said were retaliatory strikes for Ukrainian attacks on Russia. It warned foreign nationals and diplomatic staff against travelling to Ukraine.
($1 = 0.8887 euros)

items.title: テニス＝世界ランク1位シナー、マスターズ上海大会欠場を発表
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの世界ランキング１位、ヤニク・シナー（２５、イタリア）は３日、長引いている膝のけがの影響で、マスターズ上海大会（７日開幕）を欠場すると発表した。

シナーは７月１２日にウィンブルドン選手権決勝でアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）を下して以来、公式戦でプレーしていない。２０２４年のマスターズ上海大会では、決勝でノバク・ジョコビッチ（セルビア）を下し、優勝した。

シナーはインスタグラムのストーリーズに「残念ながら今年はマスターズ上海大会でプレーできない。上海のファンの前でプレーするのは楽しいだけに、来週プレーできないことを申し訳なく思う」とつづり、「来年会えることを楽しみにしています」と締めくくった。

シナーの今年の成績は４４勝３敗。ウィンブルドンで四大大会５回目の優勝を達成した。

今年のマスターズ上海大会にはディフェンディングチャンピオンのバレンティン・バチェロット（モナコ）、同大会４回優勝のジョコビッチ、世界ランク２位のズベレフ、同３位のカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）らが出場する。

７位でスタートした山下は６バーディー、１ダブルボギー、１ボギーの３アンダー６９でラウンド。通算１２アンダーの２０４とした。同じく７位で出た畑岡奈紗は２アンダー７０で回ったが、通算１１アンダーの９位に後退した。

岩井千怜と笹生優花はともに４アンダーで回り、通算９アンダーの１８位に浮上した。吉田優利と竹田麗央は通算８アンダーの２４位。西郷真央は通算７アンダーの３０位。西村優菜は４２位、櫻井心那は５３位、岩井明愛は６５位となった。

items.title: Rugby league-Nawaqanitawase tries fire Roosters to 16th NRL title
items.summary: Newcastle were looking to take the title back to their industrial port city for the first time since 2001 and scored the first two tries of the contest through Francis Manuleleua and skipper Kalyn ...
items.body:
Rugby league-Nawaqanitawase tries fire Roosters to 16th NRL title
Reuters | Updated: 04-10-2026 16:36 IST | Created: 04-10-2026 16:36 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Dual-code international winger Mark Nawaqanitawase scored two tries as the Sydney Roosters edged the Newcastle Knights 19-18 in the National Rugby League final on Sunday, securing the foundation club a 16th title. Nawaqanitawase, who could represent Australia at both the league and union World Cups over the next 12 months, crossed either side of halftime to help crush Newcastle hopes of a massive upset in front of a crowd of 80,814 at Stadium Australia.
Newcastle were looking to take the title back to their industrial port city for the first time since 2001 and scored the first two tries of the contest through Francis Manuleleua and skipper Kalyn Ponga to take an early 12-0 lead. Nawaqanitawase, playing the final game of his two-year stint at the Roosters before his return to rugby union, cut the deficit from a clever kick and chase five minutes before the break, however.
Newcastle defended several sets on their own line at the start of the second half but Roosters centre Billy Smith forced his way over in the 47th minute for a converted try that locked up the scores at 12-12. Sam Walker put the Sydney side in front for the first time with a penalty seven minutes later, and Nawaqanitawase added his second try in the right corner before the hour mark to extend the lead to 18-12.
Experienced five-eighth Daly Cherry-Evans, playing his last NRL game before his switch to England's Super League, slotted a field goal to extend the advantage to seven points but the Knights found a second wind in the remaining 11 minutes. Summoning the spirit of last week's sensational win over the Penrith Panthers with 12 men that got them to the final, they forced their way upfield and winger Greg Marzhew crossed for a converted try that made it a one-point game with four minutes on the clock.
The Roosters, one of the two clubs remaining from the first season of what became the NRL in 1908, held on, however, to secure their first title since 2019 and fourth under long-term coach Trent Robinson. "Credit to the Knights, they fought for 80 minutes there," said Nawaqanitawase.
"This is going to last me a lifetime, it's sad to go but I love everyone here, I love all the boys, and let's celebrate this win, far out."

items.title: WRAPUP 1-Games-Asian Games close after fortnight of turmoil and teenage triumph
items.summary: Read more about WRAPUP 1-Games-Asian Games close after fortnight of turmoil and teenage triumph on Devdiscourse ...
items.body:
WRAPUP 1-Games-Asian Games close after fortnight of turmoil and teenage triumph
Reuters | Updated: 04-10-2026 15:38 IST | Created: 04-10-2026 15:38 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The 20th Asian Games closed on Sunday after a rocky fortnight lit up by youthful brilliance in the sporting arenas but tempered by logistical dysfunction and subdued public interest.
Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) President Sheikh Joaan bin Hamad Al Thani declared the Games closed at Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium, with the torch handed to organisers of the next event in Doha 2030. Some 17,000 athletes and officials came for the Aichi-Nagoya showpiece, more than the Paris Olympics, competing in 469 gold-medal events spanning Tokyo to Osaka.
The massive scale clashed with organisers' planning for a "simple, streamlined and functional event" -- and the results were often chaotic. Athletes and teams complained of bungled accommodation and transport, prompting repeated apologies from the embarrassed organising committee.
Despite the challenges, the Games were lifted by the performances of teenage titans, led by China's 13-year-old swimmer Yu Zidi. Awarded the female Most Valuable Player of the Games, Yu is on track for a huge Los Angeles Olympics after claiming three individual gold medals in the Tokyo pool.
She swam the second-fastest time in winning the 200 metres individual medley, setting up a battle royale with Canada's world-record holder Summer McIntosh. Her 19-year-old teammate Zhang Zhanshuo became the first swimmer to win seven golds at the Games, while Japan's 17-year-old wunderkind Shin Ohashi smashed the 200m breaststroke world record.
Youthful brilliance lit up the athletics, with China's 18-year-old Yan Ziyi producing a world-class throw to win the women's javelin gold while 20-year-old Thai sprinter Puripol Boonson swept the 100 and 200m to become the men's MVP. NO GAMES VILLAGE
The athletes performed despite regular logistical failures and occasional diplomatic gaffes. "Accommodation, transport and other issues -- it seems a lot of teams were affected," Hong Kong team chef de mission Wong Po-kee told Reuters on Sunday.
Organisers opted to house athletes and officials in a mix of hotels, wooden container units and a cruise ship to cut costs rather than build a dedicated athletes' village. They budgeted for 15,000 athletes and officials -- about 2,000 fewer than total registrations -- and struggled to manage them.
Waves of athletes spent up to 12 hours waiting to be registered on arrival. When checking in, some found their rooms double-booked or being shared by the wrong teammates.
Transport problems dogged the Games throughout, with athletes' shuttle buses failing to turn up or taking them to the wrong venues. Several competitions were delayed by the errors. South Korea's delegation were particularly aggrieved, with their team chef de mission marking the Games' organisation with an 'F'.
Their men's soccer team were upset when the South Korean flag was unable to be hoisted for the national anthem at the victory ceremony after they beat Japan for the gold medal on Saturday. The North Korean national anthem played for South Korea's men's hockey team earlier in the Games in another awkward mix-up.
Five years after the Tokyo Olympics was staged without fans due to COVID-19 restrictions, Japan's first major multi-sport event was blighted by poor crowds. Fewer than 1,000 spectators watched the hosts beat South Korea in the women's soccer semi-finals at a 50,000-capacity stadium.
Much smaller venues were often nearly empty, though many were based in far-flung locations, making access a challenge. "If I had to say, well, I don't think it was a success," Nagoya resident Naoko Toda, who watched several competitions, told Reuters before the closing ceremony.
Despite the issues, the Games' governing OCA declared Aichi-Nagoya a success and praised organisers for their frugal arrangements. China topped the table with 169 golds among 341 medals, their best haul at an overseas Asian Games.
But Japan also delivered for fans who tuned in, with 83 golds in a total of 269 medals, smashing their previous record at Hiroshima 1994. Padel, mixed martial arts, teqball and surfing made their Games debuts in a record 43-sport programme that dwarfed the Paris Olympics.
Qatar is set to host the next Asiad in 2030, though the OCA may elect to push it back a year to serve as the continent's Olympic qualifiers before Brisbane 2032. (Additional reporting by Irene Wang in Nagoya; Editing by Christian Radnedge)

items.title: テニス＝ルバキナ、世界ランク1位としての初戦で逆転負け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３日　ロイター］ - テニスの中国オープン（ＯＰ）は３日、北京で試合を行い、女子シングルス２回戦で世界ランキング１位のエレーナ・ルバキナ（カザフスタン）が初戦敗退を喫した。

この日が初戦となった第１シードのルバキナは、アリーナ・チャラエワ（アルメニア）と対戦し、第１セットは６─３で奪ったものの、続くセットを４─６、３─６で落として逆転負け。９月の全米ＯＰで優勝し、キャリア初の世界ランク１位となったルバキナだが、トップに浮上した後の最初の試合で敗れた選手としては、大坂なおみに次ぐ史上２人目となった。

ＷＴＡランキングは１９７５年に初めて発表されたが、ＯｐｔａＡｃｅによると、それ以降で世界ランク１位の相手に逆転勝ちを収めた選手では、今回のチャラエワ（１１８位）が最もランクの低いプレーヤーだという。

ルバキナは「間違いなく、今日は非常に厳しい試合だった。全米ＯＰで優勝してからいろいろなことがあった。睡眠や回復の機会をあまり持てなかった。アリーナをお祝いしたい。彼女は素晴らしい試合をした」と話した。

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝ピストンズ、デューレンとの契約延長を正式に発表
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のピストンズが３日、制限付きフリーエージェント（ＦＡ）のセンター、ジェイレン・デューレン（２２）との契約延長を正式に発表した。

これまで米スポーツ専門チャンネルＥＳＰＮとジ・アスレチックは５年総額２億ドル（約３１６億円）と報じていたが、チームは契約の詳細を明かしていない。

ピストンズのバスケットボール運営部門代表を務めるトラジャン・ラングドン氏は「今後何年もジェイレンをチームの中心に据えられることをうれしく思う」とし、「彼は若くして多くを成し遂げており、われわれは彼の全盛期はこれからだと信じている」と述べた。

報道によると、ピストンズは最近デューレンに同じ総額２億ドルの契約を提示したものの、体重に関する条項を盛り込んでいたという。今回の合意では同条項が削除されたと報じられている。

昨季初めてオールスターとオールＮＢＡに選出されたデューレンは、レギュラーシーズンで自己最多の１試合平均１９．５得点に加え、１０．５リバウンドを記録。ピストンズは６０勝２２敗で東カンファレンス最高成績を残した。一方、プレーオフでは同１０．２得点、８．５リバウンドに数字を落とし、チームは東カンファレンス準決勝でキャバリアーズに３勝４敗で敗れた。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［コルカタ（インド）　３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［コルカタ（インド）　３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの国際親善試合が３日、各地で行われ、サムエウ・リノが代表初ゴールを決めたブラジルがアウェーでインドに４─０と快勝を収めた。

ブラジルは前半２８分、右サイドから切れ込んだエステバンがネットを揺らして先制し、さらに同４２分にはペドロのゴールもアシスト。後半１３分にリノが代表初得点を挙げると、試合終盤にリノが相手の守備をかわして自身この日２点目を記録した。

世界ランキング１３８位のインドは６戦連続で未勝利に。カルロ・アンチェロッティ監督率いるブラジルはオーストラリア戦も含めた遠征を２勝１分けとした。

items.title: Cornell president vows 'serious look' at fraternities, sororities in wake of rape allegations
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Michael Kotlikoff said the school would take steps to prevent a similar situation in the future.
items.body:
Cornell University will examine the role of fraternities and sororities on campus following an outcry over the school's handling of a student's rape allegations, the Ivy League school's president said on Saturday.
A [USN:L1N45O0OO TEXT:"civil lawsuit"] filed last month by the woman, who alleges she was drugged and raped in 2024 by several members of the Chi Phi fraternity, has sparked [USN:L6N45O0CP TEXT:"outrage and soul-searching"] at Cornell over its campus culture at the school in Ithaca, New York.
In a video message, Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff said the school would take steps to prevent a similar situation in the future. That includes "a serious look at the role of fraternities and sororities in campus life," Kotlikoff said.
"At their best, these organizations can provide students with friendship, belonging, mentorship and a powerful sense of community," he said. "But being part of a group can never diminish individual responsibility."
The university will seek input, he said, from students, alumni and others on how to "preserve what is valuable about Greek life while strengthening individual accountability, transparency and a culture in which every member understands their responsibility to protect the safety and well-being of others."
The lawsuit against Cornell, seven fraternity members and others, alleges that the school failed to adequately punish some of the accused students.
The accused men have denied all wrongdoing, the New York Times reported.
Cornell has defended its handling of the matter, saying it launched a comprehensive investigation and barred the Chi Phi fraternity from campus. The school said it imposed a range of disciplinary measures, including expulsions.
But "we must do better," Kotlikoff said. "We don’t have all the answers, but we are committed to investigating and finding the answers our community deserves."
He vowed that university officials would "be more transparent" about their actions related to the 2024 incident, but he did not detail specific initiatives that the university would take.
"In the coming weeks, we will create additional opportunities for members of our community to ask questions and hear directly from university leadership," he said.
The case has reignited scrutiny of how law enforcement and universities handle sexual assault complaints, with students questioning whether processes are enough to protect them. It has also drawn the attention of New York state officials, who have appointed a special prosecutor to investigate.

items.title: Germany's Merz visits Kyiv as Russia steps up attacks on Ukrainian cities
items.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in Kyiv Sunday in a show of support as Russia intensifies its attacks on Ukrainian cities.
items.body:
Home / World News / Germany's Merz visits Kyiv as Russia steps up attacks on Ukrainian cities

Germany's Merz visits Kyiv as Russia steps up attacks on Ukrainian cities German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in Kyiv Sunday in a show of support as Russia intensifies its attacks on Ukrainian cities.

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz | Photo: Reuters

AP Kyiv 2 min read Last Updated : Oct 04 2026 | 2:29 PM IST

Listen to This Article

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in Kyiv Sunday in a show of support as Russia intensifies its attacks on Ukrainian cities.
The aerial war has intensified, with Moscow menacing cities across Ukraine with hard-to-intercept ballistic missiles and jet-powered drones, while Kyiv has been striking Russia's oil industry and businesses.
Merz said he travelled to Kyiv, his second trip as chancellor, to demonstrate Germany's support for Ukraine.
"If Russia is not stopped, its war machine will sooner or later turn against us," he said in a statement Sunday, adding that he told Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, "You can continue to count on our help."   Merz said the partnership between the two countries was "not a one-way street," pointing to German and Ukrainian companies jointly developing technologies that benefit both sides. "This makes us safer and stronger," he said.
 

Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said the agenda would focus on "strengthening Ukraine, our defence and resilience, and our shared European security."   Russia's Foreign Ministry said Saturday it would continue to carry out "mass retaliatory strikes" on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, urging foreign nationals and diplomats to leave ?the country. It previously issued a similar warning in May.
Also Read

Germany targets two-fold rise in Indian tourist overnight stays by 2030

Russia strikes key Kyiv bridge, logistics hub in latest attacks on Ukraine

US tells France and Germany to release diesel stocks or face export ban

Russian envoy Dmitriev discussed peaceful resolution to end Ukraine war: US

Russia defies German calls to ease off its 'dangerous' escalation toward it

A Russian drone hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge over the Dnipro River again on Sunday morning. Video circulating on social media showed the drone flying into the bridge and the explosion as vehicles crossed. There was no immediate word on casualties.
The latest strike came after Russian assaults forced the full or partial closure of three of Kyiv's six road bridges over the Dnipro River earlier this week, suspending traffic and causing tailbacks in Moscow's latest effort to disrupt life in the Ukrainian capital. Previously, Russia has hit apartment blocks, supermarket warehouses, gas stations and data centers, among other targets.

Russia invaded its neighbour more than 4.5 years ago, and there are no concrete signs that a peace settlement might be possible. Fighting along the roughly 1,250-kilometre front line snaking through northern, eastern and southern Ukraine has been virtually deadlocked in recent months.

items.title: Ｆ１＝バーレーンＧＰ予選、フェルスタッペンが今季初ＰＰ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の第１６戦、バーレーン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は３日、マレーシアのセパンで予選を行い、個人総合優勝４回を誇るマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）が今季自身初のポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

フェルスタッペンは１分３５秒１３０をマーク。２番手のルイス・ハミルトン（英国、フェラーリ）を０秒２９８上回った。フェルスタッペンの同僚、アイザック・ハジャー（フランス）が３番手に入ったが、パワーユニットのコンポーネント交換で、決勝では５グリッド降格のペナルティーを受ける。

総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）は４番手でシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ、フェラーリ）が５番手。ランド・ノリス（英国）が６番手、オスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア）が７番手とマクラーレン勢が続き、総合２位のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）は８番手に終わった。

中東情勢を受けて、今大会はマレーシアで開催されている。

items.title: イエメン軍、首都サヌアでフーシ派に空爆実施
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [４日 ロイター] - イエメン軍は４日未明、首都サヌアと北西部サアダで、親イラン武装組織フーシ派
items.body:
[４日 ロイター] - イエメン軍は４日未明、首都サヌアと北西部サアダで、親イラン武装組織フーシ派 に対して攻撃を実施していると明らかにした

軍の報道官によると、同軍は「重要目標」と称する標的を攻撃したが、詳細には触れなかった。

フーシ派系のアルマシラＴＶはこれに先立ち、サウジアラビアによるサヌアへの攻撃があったと伝えた。サウジ側からの確認は直ちには得られていない。

イランが支援するフーシ派とサウジが支援する政府軍との紛争は、２０２２年の停戦後ほぼ沈静化していたが、イラン戦争の余波で戦闘が再燃している。

フーシ派は７月にサウジに対する海上封鎖を宣言し、サウジ領土や船舶への攻撃を開始。また、イエメンの紅海沿岸で大幅に勢力域を拡大した。サウジはイエメン政府軍を支援し、同国内のフーシ派拠点に空爆を実施している。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝ヤンキース主将ジャッジ、地区シリーズはロースター外
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ヤンキースが３日、レイズとの地区シリーズ（５回戦制）の２６人のロースターを発表。主将アーロン・ジャッジ外野手（３４）はメンバーを外れた。

ジャッジは右ふくらはぎの肉離れの影響で９月１６日以降プレーしておらず、その３日後に負傷者リスト（ＩＬ）入り。通算３回のア・リーグＭＶＰ（最優秀選手）選出を誇る同選手は、レッドソックスとのワイルドカードシリーズも欠場した。ヤンキースは同シリーズで２連勝し、地区シリーズに勝ち上がった。

ヤンキースのアーロン・ブーン監督は、ジャッジをロースターに入れなかったことについて「最終的にそれが最善と判断した」とコメント。「彼が復帰に近付いているように感じている」としながらも、「アーロンが本来の状態で復帰し、われわれがワールドシリーズで優勝するためには、あと１週間、彼が復帰に向けて努力を続けることが重要だ」と話した。

さらに同監督は「彼はランニングを始めたばかりで、打撃練習は数日前に再開した。これをさらに数日続けて、持久力を身に付けることが大事」とも述べた。

ジャッジは肋骨の骨折で３カ月以上離脱。９月８日に復帰した後、７試合に出場したが、打率１割７分４厘、１本塁打、３打点とふるわなかった。レギュラーシーズンでは６６試合に出場し、打率２割４分１厘、１８本塁打、４１打点だった。

items.title: サッカー＝欧州ＮＬ、イングランド7得点で大勝　スペイン3連勝
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）は３日、各地で１次リーグの試合を行い、リーグＡの３組ではイングランドが主将のハリー・ケーンらのゴールでクロアチアに７─０と大勝した。

イングランドは前半８分、ジュード・ベリンガムのパスを受けたケーンが守備陣２枚の間を抜けて先制ゴール。同２１分にベリンガムが決めて加点すると、３─０として迎えた同４５分にベリンガムのクロスからブカヨ・サカがネットを揺らした。

イングランドは後半もケーンとサカのゴールでリードを広げると、同４２分にベリンガムのお膳立てからモーガン・ロジャースにも得点が生まれた。ベリンガムは１試合１ゴール３アシスト。代表通算ゴール数を８９としたケーンは、これが１２４試合目。ピーター・シルトン氏の同代表最多出場記録まであと１試合となった。

同組のスペインはチェコを３─１で破り、開幕から３戦全勝とした。前半６分にラミン・ヤマルがペナルティーエリアの端から左足で強烈なシュートを放つと、同３５分には代表で２年以上ゴールのなかったロドリが決めて２点を先行。後半に１点を失ったが、最後はミケル・メリノのゴールで突き放した。

これにより、同組ではスペインが勝ち点９で首位、イングランドは同６で２位としている。

リーグＢの１組ではスイスがスロベニアを２─１で下して３戦全勝で首位をキープ。スコットランドは北マケドニアを２─０で破り、スロベニアと同じ勝ち点４とした。

items.title: アジア大会＝日本選手団、金メダル83個で60年ぶりに最多更新
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［３日　ロイター］　 - 愛知・名古屋アジア大会では３日、日本選手団の金メダル数が８３個に到達。これまでの記録を上回り、最多となった。１９６６年バンコク大会で記録した７８を６０年ぶりに更新した。

日本はソフトボール決勝では中国に７─０で快勝し、７連覇を達成。柔道混合団体ではカザフスタンを４─０で下し、３連覇を果たした。ラグビー７人制女子決勝では中国に１０─５で勝利し、８年ぶりの金メダル。水球男子でも優勝した。

セパタクロー男子クワッド（４人制）では日本初の金メダルに輝き、ブレイキン男子では半井重幸（ダンサー名・SHIGEKIX）が２連覇を達成。初採用のパデル、女子ダブルスは塚本早紀、徳本佳恵組が制した。

テニスの混合ダブルスでは柴原瑛菜、フレンド原ジェイ組が青山修子、楠原悠介組をストレートで下して優勝。同大会のテニス競技の決勝が日本人対決となったのは今回が初めてだった。

サッカー男子決勝では日本が韓国に０─１で敗戦。バレーボール男子決勝で、日本はイランにセットカウント１─３で負けた。

日本は今大会、３日の競技を終えた時点で銀メダルは９５個で銅メダルは９１個。金メダルと合わせて２６９個と、３４１個の中国に次ぐ２位のメダル数を記録している。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: ［クリーブランド　３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［クリーブランド　３日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）のプレーオフ、地区シリーズ（５回戦制）が３日、各地で開幕。ホワイトソックスの村上宗隆内野手はガーディアンズ戦に「４番・一塁」で出場し、四回にポストシーズン初本塁打となる先制２ランを放った。

ライトスタンドに約１３４メートルの一発をたたき込んだ村上は試合後、通訳を介し「準備はできていた。シーズンを通じてこの瞬間に向けて備えてきた」とコメントした。村上は４打数２安打２打点と活躍。ホワイトソックスは３─０でシリーズ初戦を制した。

ドジャースの大谷翔平選手はブレーブス戦に「２番・指名打者」で出場し、４打数１安打。ドジャースは５─３で勝った。先発のタリク・スクバル投手が６回１失点の好投で勝利投手となった。

Oct 3 : The White House has created a task force to examine AI's risks and opportunities and recommend what role the federal government should play in overseeing the technology, with a report due within 120 days, the Wall Street Journal reported on Saturday, citing the head of the task force, Jay Clayton.
Clayton, who heads the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, said he would lead the group, known as the "Super Intelligence Force," effectively serving as US President Donald Trump's AI czar, the report said, citing a senior White House official.

items.summary: 北朝鮮、3日に中距離ミサイル発射 極超音速兵器の部隊訓練と国営通信    jp.reuters.com
items.raw_description: 北朝鮮、3日に中距離ミサイル発射 極超音速兵器の部隊訓練と国営通信    jp.reuters.com

items.title: 北朝鮮、3日に中距離ミサイル発射　極超音速兵器の部隊訓練と国営通信
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ４日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮は４日、金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記の立ち会いの下で３日に極超音速ミサイルの発射実験を行ったと発表した。核抑止力の信頼性を示すことを目的とした訓練だとした。国営朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が伝えた。

ミサイル発射については、金総書記の妹で朝鮮労働党の金与正総務部長が３日に公表していた。ＫＣＮＡが４日に発射に関する詳細を明らかにした。

ＫＣＮＡによると、ミサイルは極超音速戦略兵器システムの一部をなす中距離戦略ミサイルで、東部から発射され、約１０００キロ離れた日本海上の目標に命中した。ミサイル部隊を訓練するとともに、抑止戦力の効率性と機動性を評価するのが目的とした。

金総書記は、こうした活動は抑止力行使の一形態だとし、戦略攻撃兵器の「信頼性と致命性」を敵に認識させる努力を続けなければならないと述べた。核戦争抑止力の開発は国家の安全保障に不不可欠で、この方針に変わりはないと改めて表明したという。

日韓の防衛当局は３日、北朝鮮が弾道ミサイルを発射したと発表した。韓国はミサイルの飛行距離を７００キロ程度、日本は６８０キロ程度と分析している。

＜日韓のミサイル追跡能力に言及＞

金与正氏は３日、韓国と日本がミサイルを追跡できなかったと主張。変則的に飛行する「波状軌道」を採用したことで、両国の追跡能力の限界が露呈したとした。

これに対し、韓国国防省は４日、発射の準備を韓国軍が綿密に監視していたとし、発射直後にミサイルを探知・追跡し、発射地点も正確に特定したと説明した。その上で、北朝鮮が最近発射したミサイルは、韓国と米国のミサイル防衛資産で探知・迎撃できる能力の範囲内にあると評価しているとした。

ＫＣＮＡは今回、正確な着弾座標を含め、異例なほど詳しい情報を公開した。

韓国統一研究院のホン・ミン上級研究員は、こうした情報公開は、ミサイルが約１０００キロ飛行したとの主張を裏付けるとともに、北朝鮮が指摘する、韓国と日本の追跡能力の弱点を浮き彫りにすることが狙いとみている。

ホン氏によると、ミサイルは２０２２年に初めて発射実験が行われた円錐形の極超音速システムとみられる。北朝鮮が実験段階から実戦配備への移行を示唆している可能性があるという。

北朝鮮が弾道ミサイルを発射したのは９月２０日以来。今回は、非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で発生した地雷の爆発を巡って韓国と非難の応酬を続ける中で実施した。

韓国は、北朝鮮の地雷で自国の兵士が重傷を負ったと主張。与正氏は２日、韓国側の非難を「根拠がない」として一蹴し、韓国側の謝罪要求も退けている。

items.raw_description: ウクライナ、ロシア製油所攻撃を強化へ 「新ドクトリンに対抗」    Reuters

items.title: ウクライナ、ロシア製油所攻撃を強化へ　「新ドクトリンに対抗」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Daniel Flynn　Olena Harmash

［キーウ　３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Daniel Flynn　Olena Harmash

［キーウ　３日　ロイター］ - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアがキーウなどの都市から住民を退去させることを狙った新たな空爆方針を打ち出したとして、対抗措置としてロシアの製油所への攻撃を強化すると述べた。ただ、民間人は標的にしないと強調した。ロイターのインタビューで語った。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、ウクライナの情報機関は、ロシアのプーチン大統領が冬を前に、これまでよりはるかに広範な民間施設への軍事攻撃を認める「新たなドクトリン」を示した文書を入手した。

ゼレンスキー氏は「われわれは文書を確認しており、インフラや物流施設、特に都市や村、あらゆる場所の道路、学校、病院への攻撃を認めていることを把握している」と説明。「首都や各地の都市から立ち去るよう住民に圧力をかける。これが作戦の目的だ」と述べた。

背景には、前線の重要地域でロシア軍が支配地を失い、死傷者も増える中、プーチン氏が強さを誇示したいと考えていることがあると指摘した。

ロシア大統領府のコメントは得られていない。一方、ロシア外務省は、外国人にキーウからの退去を促す声明で、ここ数カ月のウクライナによる対ロシア攻撃への報復として、今後も組織的な攻撃を続けると表明した。

items.title: Brazil's Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro wrap up campaigns ahead of first-round vote
items.author: Lisandra Paraguassu, Sebastian Rocandio
items.creator: Lisandra Paraguassu, Sebastian Rocandio
items.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro wrapped up their campaigns on Saturday ahead of Sunday's first-round presidential election, each expressing confidence of victory despite polls pointing to a likely runoff.
items.body:
Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro wrapped up their campaigns on Saturday ahead of Sunday's first-round [USN:L6N45K0PD TEXT:"presidential election"], each expressing confidence of victory despite polls pointing to a [USN:S0N45F00D TEXT:"likely runoff"].
[USN:L6N45K0PD TEXT:"Lula"] ended his re-election campaign with a march through Sao Paulo that drew large crowds of supporters, while [USN:L1N45F0NC TEXT:"Bolsonaro"] took part in a motorcycle caravan through Santa Barbara d'Oeste and Americana in Sao Paulo state and later rallied in Rio de Janeiro.
Lula's camp hailed the event as a record turnout, larger than the closing rally of his 2022 campaign.
Organizers said some 150,000 supporters filled the two-kilometer stretch of Augusta Street between Paulista Avenue and Roosevelt Square, a traditional stage for political demonstrations in Brazil's largest city.
Speaking from a campaign vehicle, Lula called Sunday's election a choice between "democracy and barbarism."
The head of the leftist leader's Workers' Party, Edinho Silva, said the turnout reflected growing momentum for Lula.
"Unlike other Latin American countries, where we saw a right-wing wave at the end, here in Brazil we're seeing a wave in our favor," Silva said.
Right-wing Senator Bolsonaro urged supporters to turn out to vote and predicted a first-round win.
"I am convinced that everything is in place for us to win this election in the first round," the lawmaker said.
Flavio was photographed holding a placard bearing the image of his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest after being convicted of attempting to overturn the 2022 election result, which he lost to Lula.
If no candidate wins more than 50% of valid votes -- which exclude blank and null ballots -- in Sunday's first-round vote, the two frontrunners advance to a second-round runoff on October 25.

items.title: フーシ派、リヤドのアラムコ施設攻撃と発表　サウジの攻撃に報復
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３日　ロイター］ - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は３日、サウジアラビアの首都リヤドにあるサウジアラムコの施設を弾道ミサイルと無人機で攻撃したと発表した。イエメンの首都サヌアやその他の州へのサウジの攻撃に対する報復だとしている。

これに先立ち、リヤドにあるアラムコ施設の近くから大量の煙と炎が上がったとの目撃者情報が出ていた。

アラムコ施設への攻撃について、サウジ当局は今のところ確認していない。アラムコもコメント要請に応じていない。

サウジとフーシ派の衝突は激しさを増し、フーシ派はサウジの都市やエネルギーインフラへの攻撃を強めている。

フーシ派は先週、サウジ西部ヤンブーにあるアラムコの施設をミサイルと無人機で攻撃したと発表した。サウジはその際、フーシ派がタイフとヤンブー周辺に向けて撃った弾道ミサイル６発を撃墜したと説明したが、アラムコ施設の被害については明らかにしなかった。

OpenAI safety employee quits, says 'time for trial and error is over'

Oct 3 : A former OpenAI safety employee who recently resigned criticized the company's approach to AI safety, arguing that a fast-paced culture focused on rapid development increases the risk of failures.
Writing in "I Quit OpenAI Because Its Culture Is Broken," published by the Atlantic on Saturday, David Robinson said AI companies, including OpenAI, were not being "nearly careful enough" and should place greater emphasis on safety expertise and research before developing more capable systems.
• "The time for trial and error is over," Robinson wrote, arguing that advanced AI systems require safeguards more akin to those used in industries such as nuclear power and aviation.
• Robinson said OpenAI relies heavily on what it calls "iterative deployment," releasing systems and strengthening safeguards when problems emerge.

• The comments add to a debate within the AI industry over whether companies are moving too quickly to develop increasingly powerful systems. OpenAI and rival Anthropic have faced scrutiny after incidents in which safety controls failed, or experimental systems behaved unexpectedly.
• Robinson, who said he spent 3-1/2 years at OpenAI, helped draft the company's preparedness framework and oversaw safety reports for 12 frontier-model launches, wrote: "As the company sprints from one launch to the next, it is failing to achieve the level of care that I believe is needed."
• "We're making sure our models don't become more capable than we can safely manage and secure, and we pause training or hold back models when we need to slow down," an OpenAI spokesperson said in a statement.
• Robinson also warned that AI capabilities were advancing faster than researchers' understanding of alignment, a field focused on ensuring AI systems act in accordance with human goals and values.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Lula ahead in polls for Brazil's first-round vote; runoff likely
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A series of polls on Saturday showed Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva slightly ahead of Senator Flavio Bolsonaro before Sunday's first-round vote, and a close race in a likely runoff between the leftist incumbent and his right-wing challenger.
items.body:
A series of polls on Saturday showed Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva slightly ahead of Senator Flavio Bolsonaro before Sunday's first-round vote, and a close race in a likely runoff between the leftist incumbent and his right-wing challenger.
If no candidate wins more than 50% of valid votes -- which exclude blank and null ballots -- on Sunday, the two frontrunners advance to a second-round runoff on October 25.
CNT/MDA POLL First round (valid votes): Lula 47.8%, Bolsonaro 42.1%, Augusto Cury 3.6%, Ronaldo Caiado 3.4%, Renan Santos 1.7%, Romeu Zema 0.9%
Runoff: Lula 47.3%, Bolsonaro 43.1%
MDA surveyed 2,007 people from September 30 to October 2; margin of error of 2.2 percentage points
DATAFOLHA First round (valid votes): Lula 45%, Bolsonaro 42%, Caiado 4%, Santos 3%, Cury 3%, Zema 1%
Runoff: Lula 47%, Bolsonaro 46%
Datafolha surveyed 4,006 people from October 2-3; margin of error 2 percentage points
QUAEST POLL First round (valid votes): Lula 46%, Bolsonaro 45%, Cury 3%, Santos 3%, Caiado 3%
Runoff: Bolsonaro 44%, Lula 42%
Quaest surveyed 3,702 people from October 2-3; margin of error 2 percentage points
ATLASINTEL/BLOOMBERG POLL First round (valid votes): Lula 47%, Bolsonaro 44.1%, Santos 4.6%, Cury 2.1%, Caiado 1.4%
Runoff: Lula 47.6%, Bolsonaro 47.4%
AtlasIntel surveyed 4,945 people from September 27 to October 2; margin of error 1 percentage point

LONDON: Two Iranian nationals appeared in a London court on Saturday (Oct 3) charged with plotting acts of terrorism involving the use of a homemade bomb to attack the Jewish community in northern England at the behest of a figure believed to be based in Iran.
Rahman Salehi, 34, and Salam Ahmadyan, 36, were arrested on Sep 20 at the start of Yom Kippur, the holiest day in the Jewish calendar, when they are accused of carrying out "hostile" surveillance on potential Jewish targets in Manchester, prosecutors say.
These targets included the Manchester Jewish Museum and Heaton Park synagogue, the scene of a deadly attack almost a year ago in which two Jewish worshippers were killed, prosecutor Mark Luckett told Westminster Magistrates' Court.
ALLEGED PLOT INVOLVED HOMEMADE DEVICE "Both defendants are accused of preparing acts of terrorism targeting the Jewish community in Manchester through the use of a homemade explosive device," Luckett said.

He said the men were accused of being in contact with a third party who is alleged to have directed and coordinated the attack planning and provided instructions on how to assemble a homemade device, which prosecutors allege would have been made from chlorine and brake fluid.
"It's assessed that this individual is also an Iranian national and most likely operating from within Iran," Luckett said.

Related:

UK's Starmer convenes community leaders to fight antisemitism after attacks

Two Jewish men stabbed in London, police treat attack as terrorism

The court was told both men had come to Britain from Europe in small boats. Salehi had arrived in 2020 and had been granted asylum, while Ahmadyan came in 2023 and his asylum claim was still outstanding, Luckett said.
The men did not enter a plea and were remanded in custody until their next hearing at London's Old Bailey court on Oct 23.
The case comes a week after Britain said Iran was believed to be involved in a suspected plot to target the RAF Fairford air base which the US military has used to carry out raids against targets in Iran, leading to a dual British-Iranian national being arrested on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts.
Police said on Saturday he had been released on police bail while the investigation continues. British counterterrorism police have said the Manchester allegations were not connected in any way to the Fairford investigation.
Iran has rejected accusations of involvement in a number of plots in Britain in recent years, and said allegations it was connected to the Fairford incident were baseless.
Britain has also seen a significant rise in antisemitism since the Hamas attacks on Israel in October 2023 that triggered the subsequent war in Gaza, including a series of attacks on Jewish sites in London earlier this year.
"It is no secret that this country faces a range of serious threats from the Iranian regime," Home Secretary (interior minister) Shabana Mahmood said in a statement.
"They target our Jewish communities and try to silence their critics overseas, often through proxies and criminal networks to hide their involvement."

Source: Reuters/ec

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 3 : US President Donald Trump spent Tuesday showcasing his administration’s approach to AI — touting the US government’s new AI chatbot, dining with tech titans at the White House, and announcing a voluntary agreement with those executives that he said would address growing fears about the technology's safety.
The display signaled that Trump is eager to show he is addressing growing voter concerns about AI's dangers without imposing restrictions that could hamper the technology's development, AI safety advocates said. The safety agreement with six companies — Nvidia, SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Alphabet’s Google — includes no stated consequences if a company chooses not to comply. Trump described it as “morally binding.”
“This was an attempt to give the impression that the government is listening to these concerns without undercutting what has been a very clear and consistent line from this administration: that regulation and governance inherently impede innovation,” said Kat Duffy, who runs an AI team at the nonpartisan Council on Foreign Relations.
Whether voters buy Trump's effort in the run-up to US midterm elections on November 3 remains to be seen. Public uneasiness with AI, and the small group of people who seemingly hold sway over it, has risen in recent months. Three-quarters of Americans worry that AI companies have not gone far enough to prevent AI from causing serious harm to society, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll published September 22. A series of security events has also underscored how advanced AI can act unpredictably.

Hundreds of OpenAI AI agents broke out of their testing environment in July and attacked the infrastructure of AI platform Hugging Face. In early September, Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned, saying that the people building AI believe it "could kill us all by the end of the decade." His words, and others, sparked a flurry of calls from US lawmakers for AI regulation. 
Through it all, Trump has largely dismissed those concerns, saying that government restrictions would make it harder for American companies to compete against their Chinese counterparts. He has repeatedly said that US law enforcement agencies such as the Justice Department serve as sufficient guardrails, and that no new rules are needed. He also directed his administration to call AI "super intelligence," part of an effort to improve the reputation of an unpopular technology. 
The concerns have become prominent enough to make their way into late-night comedy. In late September, "Saturday Night Live" satirized Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, one of the industry's most outspoken voices on AI risks — even as his company readies a public stock sale that could value it at $2 trillion — with cast member Jane Wickline portraying the executive.
"AI is not a weapon, it’s a tool: A tool for building weapons. And I urge you to urge me to stop," Wickline said as Amodei.
CONCERNS ABOUT ENFORCEMENT
The accord, inked Tuesday, does include measures that AI safety advocates have sought, including calling for “robust internal controls” to prevent unauthorized hacks as well as partnering with “independent external auditors.” Those concepts have been included in draft state and federal legislation, and California in September enacted the first state law setting rules for how independent auditors evaluate AI products.
But the one-page White House document did not address details or enforcement mechanisms.
A White House official said in a statement that the agreement will "advance American innovation and strengthen responsible development" of AI models. Trump is expected to name his Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as his top AI adviser, Reuters previously reported, a position he has dubbed "AI czar," even as Clayton stays in his role leading the nation's intelligence agencies.
Representative Ro Khanna, a Democrat representing Silicon Valley, welcomed the idea of "independent auditors" but said that they should report to an independent federal agency.
"They can’t just be auditors that report to (OpenAI CEO) Sam Altman or Dario Amodei," he said. "My concern is the president basically trusting these guys who have a huge profit motive and won’t have the judgment to keep us safe."
Venture capitalist David Sacks, who advises Trump on AI and has been an advocate for unrestricted AI development, said on the social media platform X that securities law and other legal authorities would penalize companies that fail to address problems uncovered by internal controls or auditors.
But AI safety advocates told Reuters those authorities can only address harms after they occur, saying the threats require safeguards designed to prevent large-scale harm before it happens.
Nevertheless, some AI observers saw the simple fact of hosting the event as an indication that Trump is absorbing the worries.
Trump’s agreement with the tech executives is “a shift toward acknowledging that there are serious safety and security concerns that merit closer coordination between the companies,” said Samuel Hammond, AI policy director at the conservative Foundation for American Innovation.

Source: Reuters

MANILA: The Philippines, chair of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), expressed concern over an airstrike in Myanmar's Rakhine state that caused deaths, injuries and destruction, and stood ready to facilitate discussions within the regional bloc on how best to assist Myanmar.
"The Philippines is closely monitoring developments and expresses concern over the attacks which resulted in destruction, loss of lives and injuries to those affected," Foreign Affairs Assistant Secretary for ASEAN Affairs Ana Marie Hernando said in an email response on Saturday (Oct 3).
As ASEAN chair, Manila said it remained mindful of the views of all member states and would continue to be guided by the regional bloc's consensus-based approach.
The Philippines said it stood ready to facilitate discussions within ASEAN on ways to assist Myanmar, in line with the common aspiration of finding a solution that is "Myanmar-owned and led".
Monday's Kyauktaw airstrike, Rakhine's deadliest such attack since a December hospital bombing, killed 50 people and wounded dozens more.
Myanmar has been locked in a nationwide civil war since a 2021 coup, with an alliance of armed groups, including the Arakan Army, fighting against the military.
The protracted conflict has since killed around 100,000 people and displaced more than 3.5 million in the impoverished Southeast Asian nation.

Source: Reuters/js

High school students in Paris' deprived suburbs spark national protest movement

While France ranks in the middle of OECD countries for spending on education, the average expenditure per secondary school student has remained little changed over the last decade.

Police officers stand in front of protestors amid tear gas as protesting students carry out blockading action near the Kerichen high school in Brest, western France, on Oct 2, 2026. (Photo: AFP/Fred Tanneau)

(Updated: 03 Oct 2026 03:42PM)

FAST

AUBERVILLIERS: Maisa, a 17-year-old in a poor Paris suburb who aspires to be an English teacher, joined tens of thousands of other students and their supporters this week in protests that spread across France over dilapidated schools, classroom overcrowding and teacher shortages. 
At Lycee Le Corbusier school in Aubervilliers, a suburb north of Paris in the Seine-Saint-Denis department, protesters said schools in poor neighbourhoods like theirs faced the worst conditions.
“Last year I took the high school French exam without a French teacher, and teachers have a huge impact,” Maisa said.
"These are not conditions to study in."

As protests raged at more than 1,200 French high schools this week, police responded with tear gas and rubber bullets in some cases. More than 5,000 people were arrested, and some protesters were seriously hurt with eye injuries, broken teeth and blows to the head. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez called it a "climate of unacceptable violence" and called for order.
Amelia, 15, joined Maisa in the crowd outside the school gates and held a sign reading, "Our address should not decide our future". She said she was demonstrating to demand the same rights as students elsewhere in the country.      
"The education authority is not investing enough in the suburbs. It's classist and racist," she said. 
Ulysse Rabate, a political scientist at Paris 8 University, said the protests show the way that France's marginalised urban neighbourhoods are increasingly influencing national politics.
"When there is a collapse of the public service, of public education, those who feel it the most, and the most violently, are those at bottom," he said.

A French firefighter extinguishes a fire on the street amid clashes between protesters and police during a high school students protest in Pantin near Paris as part of nationwide protests to demand the hiring of substitute teachers, increased resources and better learning conditions, as more than 400 schools remain closed following days of student protests that have escalated into violence in some places, France, Oct 2, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Tom Nicholson)

POLITICAL FLASHPOINT The nationwide demonstrations and blockades , which began last week, have become a political flashpoint at a sensitive moment for the government, which announced a series of deeply unpopular spending cuts in its 2027 budget on Thursday.
The education budget is set to increase by a below-inflation 1.7 per cent to €65.53 billion, excluding teacher pensions.
The education ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Education Minister Edouard Geffray said that education remained a priority and the below-inflation budget increase was due to population decline.
The protests started in the Parisian suburbs, where poverty levels are high, then spread to Paris itself and other French towns, including Marseille, Strasbourg, Tours and Lille. 
At Lycee Le Corbusier, classes including maths, humanities, English and sport have been canceled since the start of the academic year due to a teacher shortage, according to Karima Kara Ali, an elected parent representative. 
In Seine-Saint-Denis, two-thirds of high schools took part in protests on Thursday, the CGT labour union said. Youth, teachers and parents in four towns complained of unsanitary school conditions and chronic staff shortages including of nurses and social workers. 
Louise Paternoster, a representative for the Seine-Saint-Denis branch of the CGT's education union, said the area does not get adequate resources for its student population and their educational needs.
Two-thirds of schools in the department have unfilled teacher positions, according to a union survey.

A student carries a barrier in front of a banner which reads "equal opportunities" suspended on the front of Louis-le-Grand high school in central Paris, on Oct 2, 2026. (Photo: AFP/Simon Wohlfahrt)

NOT ENOUGH TEACHERS "Our students are losing out on study time. Some schools don't have drinking water. We are not equal to other departments," she said, blaming shortages on government cuts of 3,256 teacher positions nationwide in 2026.
In Pantin, a town on the northeastern edge of Paris, teacher Dilan Roche joined her students as they protested outside their school this week to support their demands and protect them from the police.
"What they wrote on banners, we wrote in a letter to the local education authority: overcrowded classes, no nurses, no social workers - which is problematic for students with learning difficulties, many living in precarity," she said.
While France ranks in the middle of OECD countries for spending on education, the average expenditure per secondary school student has remained little changed over the last decade, standing at €11,660 in 2024 and €11,910 in 2010, according to education ministry data. 
The last nationwide high school protest movement on this scale demanding more funding came in the 1990s. That followed the government sharply expanding access to the baccalauréat, the school-leaving exam that typically paves the way to university, without providing schools with sufficient additional resources, said Professor Clemence Cardon-Quint at Paul Valery University, who researches education funding. 
The movement won an increase in funding, but spending per student later stagnated despite growing demands on schools.
Cardon-Quint said students and teachers have taken on additional responsibilities over the years, including navigating Parcoursup, the university admissions system introduced in 2018 and criticised by some students and teachers as opaque and discriminatory.
"In a period of budgetary restraint, it is more difficult to reduce inequalities," said Cardon-Quint.

Source: Reuters/ec

items.body:
［ドバイ／エルサレム　３日　ロイター］ - アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のドバイからイスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたＵＡＥの格安航空（ＬＣＣ）フライドバイ機内で副操縦士が機長を刺した事件で、ＵＡＥの検事総長は３日、副操縦士が飛行中に「テロ」攻撃を実行しようとしたと述べた。国営通信ＷＡＭが伝えた。  　

ハマド・サイフ・アル・シャムシ検事総長は「フライドバイＦＺ１０７３便を巡る事件の捜査で、副操縦士がテロ攻撃を企てていたことが判明した」と述べた。 

副操縦士は操縦室内に備え付けられている非常時用のおの（クラッシュアックス） で機長を襲い、機長に代わって操縦しようとしたという。検事総長は、容疑者の動機を含めＦＺ１０７３便を巡る捜査は続いており、「必要な手続き」が済み次第、結果を公表すると述べた。 

ＵＡＥ大統領の上級顧問を務めるアンワル・ガルガシュ氏は、ＵＡＥはテロを一切容認せず、過激主義的な言説にも寛容な姿勢は取らないとＸに投稿した。 

ＵＡＥ当局は副操縦士の身元を公表していないが、関係者は、オマーン国籍のハマム・アルハマミ容疑者だと述べた。捜査について説明を受けた別の関係筋も、その名前を確認した。ＵＡＥ当局は、容疑者の身元に関するロイターの問い合わせに返答していない。

フライドバイの広報担当者は、事件の詳しい状況は引き続き調査中で、これ以上のコメントはできないと述べた。

＜イスラエル、捜査に参加の意向、オマーンは沈黙＞ 

副操縦士は、同機が緊急着陸したサウジアラビアで身柄を拘束された。サウジ内務省によると、機長とともに１日朝にサウジからアブダビに向かった。

同機の搭乗客は大半がイスラエル人だった。イスラエル政府当局者は２日、ＵＡＥ主導の捜査に加わり、何が起きたのかを解明し、容疑者の動機や経歴を調べるとロイターに語った。捜査について説明を受けた関係筋は２日、イスラエルの当局者がＵＡＥで副操縦士を事情聴取する見通しだと述べた。どの機関や当局が聴取するかは明らかにしなかった。

副操縦士について、イスラエル側は早い段階からオマーン国籍だと指摘していた。イスラエルとオマーンの間に正式な外交関係はなく、イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は、そうした国の操縦士がイスラエル便を運航することは認められていないと述べている。副操縦士がテルアビブ便の乗務に就いた経緯は分かっていない。オマーンは事件についてコメントしていない。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: ［フランクフルト　２日　ロイター］ - ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）のナーゲル総裁は２日、同国の今年の成長率が１％前後...
items.body:
独経済、今年1％前後成長も　財政支出と輸出寄与と連銀総裁
10/3 15:46 配信

2023年11月、キプロス中央銀行で開催された会合で撮影　REUTERS/Yiannis Kourtoglou

［フランクフルト　２日　ロイター］ - ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）のナーゲル総裁は２日、同国の今年の成長率が１％前後になる可能性があると述べた。堅調な輸出需要と政府投資が寄与する。同中銀が６月に示した予測（０．５％）の２倍となる。

ドイツは過去３年間ほとんど成長していない。イラン戦争に起因するエネルギー価格高騰が産業に打撃を与えている。

ナーゲル氏は講演で、生産は予想外に底堅いと指摘した。潜在成長率は依然として低いものの、ドイツは景気循環上の回復局面にあるとの認識を示した。

「年平均で１％前後の実質経済成長となる可能性は十分にある」と述べ、「３年間の停滞を経て、これは確かに小さいながらも歓迎すべき兆しとなるだろう」とした。

ナーゲル氏は、連邦政府の国防やインフラなどに重点を置いた財政支出を成長けん引役の一つとし、予想外に堅調な海外需要の恩恵も受けているとした。

ドイツの主要経済研究所も先月下旬に、今年と来年の経済成長率予測を上方修正した。今年の成長率予測は０．６％から１．３％に引き上げられた。

Analysis:AI's race to transform the world before the money runs out

FILE PHOTO: "AI Artificial Intelligence" words, a keyboard and a robotics hand in this illustration taken, September 23, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

FAST

LONDON, Oct 3 : Never has so much cash flowed into a new technology as is pouring into AI, eclipsing the sums splurged on railways or the internet when those technological revolutions sucked in capital.
Cumulative spending globally on data centers alone could top $30 trillion by 2050, according to a projection by PwC, almost matching the value of outstanding US Treasuries. It "dwarfs" what was spent in the railroad or dotcom booms, even after adjusting for inflation, PwC said.
Meanwhile, Anthropic, just one of the major firms in the AI race, plans to spend $518 billion in coming years, according to the IPO prospectus seen by Reuters, which is more than 100 times its 2025 revenue. Its backers say AI technology will be more transformational than the advent of steam engines and the industrialization they powered.
Yet lurking behind the dizzying projections and huge outlays by AI companies, alongside sky-high valuations, lie assumptions about vast broad-based productivity gains and future profits with little evidence so far - or historical precedent - to be sure they can deliver, economists say.

PRODUCTIVITY GAINS 'REMAIN ELUSIVE'
JP Morgan wrote in August that broad-based productivity gains in the US, which leads the AI race, "remain elusive", raising questions about the sustainability of AI valuations.
A Bain & Company study said productivity gains from existing markets would not be enough to justify current outlays and "entirely new markets must emerge to close the funding gap", suggesting those could range from using AI-guided robots to developing new materials for batteries and semiconductors.
US hyperscalers - the companies rolling out infrastructure around the world like Google, Amazon and Microsoft - and others in the AI race needed to find more than $4.2 trillion of new revenue in the next five years to fund the buildout, Bain said.
"The question is whether the applications arrive in time to pay for it," according to the study, published last month.
Few doubt the potential of AI to transform everything from work in an office to research labs, just as past revolutions shrank journey times from days to hours or connected the world at the touch of a keyboard.
What seems more immutable is the maths behind securing a return on investment or the deadlines for repaying loans, leaving economists to work out the implications for the global economy beyond the ups and downs of investment cycles.
"Historical precedent suggests that technology-driven booms often end when infrastructure buildouts cease to deliver sufficient returns," JP Morgan wrote.
Using the example of Nvidia, the US company whose chips are the backbone of the AI revolution, JP Morgan estimated US productivity gains would need to be 3 per cent to 5 per cent annually over the next 10 years to justify its valuation. That would be a substantial increase from the baseline expectation of the US Congressional Budget Office of 1.75 per cent annual productivity growth for that period.
For the US alone - which according to some estimates accounts for about three quarters of the global AI investment total - investment will run as high as about $9 trillion from 2025 to 2032, equivalent to spending 3.2 per cent of US GDP each year, according to Columbia Business School economist Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh.
He estimates the US AI sector would need to generate about $3.55 trillion in annual revenue by 2032 to earn a 10 per cent return on investment. It earns a fraction of that now.
The leveraged structure of much of the debt funding AI infrastructure also means "a relatively modest deterioration in demand, delays, or asset values can therefore produce much larger losses," he wrote in a conference paper, revised in October.
AI AND 'THE RATE OF NEW WONDERS'
The dizzying numbers have not stopped US AI bosses speaking with an otherworldly zeal about changes afoot.
Anthropic's Dario Amodei has said an AI future could be "a thing of transcendent beauty", while OpenAI's Sam Altman has said "the rate of new wonders being achieved will be immense" as models learn to improve themselves and accelerate breakthroughs.
Jasjeet Sekhon, chief strategy officer at Google DeepMind, told a summit at UC Berkeley in August that this self-teaching, known as recursive self-improvement, was a "key part of the investment thesis", and that it could, if achieved, deliver unprecedented productivity gains.
Recursive self-improvement, while potentially delivering exponential AI advances, has also raised concerns about existential risks to humanity.
Yet the pace of change in productivity might still end up lagging the timelines needed by corporate accounts departments.
Diane Coyle, an economist at Britain's Cambridge University, said the productivity impact of past revolutionary technologies had usually taken about 10 to 50 years to feed through.
Anthropic's economics team modeled a range of scenarios for how much extra growth AI would deliver at an annual rate in 2030. Assuming a baseline of 2 per cent in a non-AI environment, it suggested growth of 2.4 per cent in a scenario with modest AI impact, 5.4 per cent in a substantial scenario and 15.4 per cent in an extreme scenario.
Higher growth would mean more jobs lost, it said, without assigning probabilities for any of the outcomes.
Amodei forecast last year that AI could wipe out half of all entry-level white-collar jobs within five years. For now, however, some researchers say it appears to have been limited to making it harder for those seeking office work to find a job.
Studies in the US and Britain have pointed to a slowdown in early career hiring for white-collar positions performing tasks at which AI is adept, even if overall employment remains strong.
Researchers at Stanford University said in August that employment of workers aged 22 to 25 in AI-exposed industries, such as accountants and paralegals, was 19 per cent lower than for jobs that AI found hard to replicate, like janitors and builders.
Yet even if the promised transformation takes longer than numbers surrounding AI companies imply, real economic benefits should stay - just as trains still ran after the Panic of 1873 that bankrupted railroad barons, while the internet didn't shut down after the 1990s dotcom bubble burst.
"History is our friend in trying to understand this," said Coyle. "As long as one is left with the infrastructure that's needed to support all the productivity effects down the road, that's okay."

Source: Reuters

items.title: アップル、Ｍａｃのアクセス権限制御強化へ　ＡＩリスク対策
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Stephen Nellis

[サンフランシスコ ２日 ロイター] - 米アップルは２日、同社のＰＣ「Ｍａｃ」の基本ソ...
items.body:
アップル、Ｍａｃのアクセス権限制御強化へ　ＡＩリスク対策
10/3 13:57 配信

3月にニューヨーク市で開催されたアップルのイベント　REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton

Stephen Nellis

[サンフランシスコ ２日 ロイター] - 米アップルは２日、同社のＰＣ「Ｍａｃ」の基本ソフト（ＯＳ）を修正すると明らかにした。人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェントがＭａｃ内の全データへのアクセスを求めた場合に、利用者がより明確に認識し対応できるようにする。

メタ・プラットフォームズのＡＩエージェント「Ｍｕｓｅ」について、一部ユーザーから、機密性の高い個人情報にアクセスされたとの批判が出ている。

アップルのスマートフォン「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ」やタブレット端末「ｉＰａｄ」では、「サンドボックス化」と呼ばれる仕組みにより、初期設定ではどのアプリも別のアプリ内のデータにアクセスできない。一方、Ｍａｃはより柔軟な設計となっており、利用者の許可があれば、クラウドバックアップサービスなどのアプリが端末内の全データにアクセスできる「フルディスクアクセス」という設定がある。

アップルは２日、自社のサイトで、一部の開発者が利用者を危険にさらしかねない形でフルディスクアクセス機能を使っていると指摘し、今後、追加の制御機能を導入すると表明した。

「ＡＩエージェントの能力と自律性が高まるにつれ、これほど広範なアクセスに伴うリスクは大幅に増大する。利用者が自身のデータとプライバシーについて十分な情報に基づいて判断できるよう、アクセスを許可する前にこうしたリスクを明確に理解できるようにすることに取り組む」とした。

TOKYO, Oct 3 : Japan's government has begun recalibrating its messaging to reassure markets that Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is not pursuing reflationary policies, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said in an interview with broadcaster TV Tokyo on Saturday.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent views Takaichi's economic policies as suited to current economic conditions, but has questioned whether the government has been communicating that message clearly enough to investors, Katayama said.
"So we concluded around late August that we need to communicate that message more clearly to financial markets," Katayama said, addressing market perceptions that the administration's policies are reflationary.

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター

items.summary:
Michael S. Derby

[２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２日、９月の米雇用...
items.body:
9月雇用統計はトレンドに整合、次回会合までにさらなる情報＝クリーブランド連銀総裁
10/3 10:19 配信

ニューヨーク市で2025年11月撮影　REUTERS/Brendan McDermid/File Photo

Michael S. Derby

[２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２日、９月の米雇用統計は最近の雇用情勢と整合的との認識を示した上で、今後の金融政策を決めるまでにはまだ時間があると述べた。

ハマック氏は米公共放送ＰＢＳの番組「ニュースアワー」のインタビューで、「過去１２カ月は平均で毎月４万１０００人の雇用が生まれている。これは私が推計する（雇用セクターの）ブレークイーブンとおおむね一致する」と述べ、労働市場が安定的に推移していることを示唆するとした。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策対応については、「月末の会合までに、さらに多くの情報が得られる。２つの責務を確実に果たせるよう、適切な政策スタンスを決める時間は十分にある」と語った。

ＦＲＢは先月、約３年ぶりに０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定した。ハマック氏は、早い段階から利上げを支持してきた。

今週、複数のＦＲＢ高官が、追加利上げの前にデータを見極める時間があるとの認識を示した。また９月の雇用統計発表後、１０月２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ観測が後退し、ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチでは据え置きの確率が８６％となっている。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Erwin Seba

[ヒューストン　２日　ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は反落して取引を終えた。欧州首脳が、価...
items.body:
原油先物反落、Ｇ７が石油備蓄1億バレル協調放出で合意
10/3 6:28 配信

英ロンドンのガソリンスタンドで２日撮影。REUTERS/Toby Melville

Erwin Seba

[ヒューストン　２日　ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は反落して取引を終えた。欧州首脳が、価格引き下げに向けてディーゼル燃料（軽油）の備蓄を放出するよう求めていた米国の要請に応じることで合意した。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．０６ドル（０．０６％）安の１バレル＝１０２．２５ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．７６ドル（１．９０％）安の１バレル＝９１．１１ドル。

主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は２日の首脳共同声明で、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）を通じてディーゼル燃料などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。Ｇ７の発表に先立ち、トランプ米大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で「欧州は大量に備蓄しているディーゼルを大規模に放出することに合意した。手続きは直ちに開始される」と表明していた。

プライス・フューチャーズ・グループのシニアアナリスト、フィル・フリン氏は「欧州はかなり脆弱だと感じている」とし、「（米国が）ディーゼルの輸出禁止を発動すれば、欧州は最も打撃を受ける地域の１つとなるだろう」と述べた。

items.title: 米国株式市場＝続伸、雇用統計受け利上げ観測後退　小型株高い
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Chuck Mikolajczak

[ニューヨーク　２日　ロイター] - 米国株式市場は続伸して取引を終えた。この日発...
items.body:
米国株式市場＝続伸、雇用統計受け利上げ観測後退　小型株高い
10/3 6:26 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）前で２０２１年７月撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

Chuck Mikolajczak

[ニューヨーク　２日　ロイター] - 米国株式市場は続伸して取引を終えた。この日発表された雇用統計の内容を受け、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による今月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ観測が後退した。

米労働省労働統計局が発表した９月の雇用統計によると、非農業部門雇用者数は２万９０００人増で、前月から伸びが鈍化し市場予想を下回った。過去２カ月分も大幅に下方改定された。失業率は４．２％で、前月の４．１％から上昇した。

これを受け、ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが１０月のＦＯＭＣで少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）利上げするとの観測は２２．７％と、前日の２４．４％、１週間前の６４．２％から低下した。 

ニューヨークのサミットＴＸキャピタルのトレーディング責任者ロバート・バーンストン氏は「本日の統計は、景気が急速に過熱していないという意味では悪くない」と指摘。その上で、「しかし、短期的な利上げ観測を後退させる点では良いが、景気やインフレを巡る懸念もあるため、市場は慎重ながらも楽観的な姿勢を取っている」と述べた。

利上げ観測の後退を受け、金利に敏感な銘柄が買われた。Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の不動産セクターは０．４％高、中小型株で構成するラッセル２０００指数は０．９％高と、１日としては過去１カ月で最大の上昇率となった。

大型株も相場をけん引し、エヌビディアは１．３％高、 テスラは４．７％高と、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種を大きく押し上げた。テスラの上昇を受けＳ＆Ｐの一般消費財セクターは１．４％ 高と、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種のうち最も高いパフォーマンスとなった。

スポーツ用品大手ナイキは３．６％安。同社は１日、２０２７会計年度売上高が１桁台後半の減少率になるとの見通しを示したほか、追加の人員削減や世界事業の再編を含む新たな経営改善策を発表した。

データ記憶装置メーカーの株価も下落。ウエスタン・デジタルとシーゲイト・テクノロジーはいずれも約１０％急落し、Ｓ＆Ｐの情報技術セクターで下落率トップとなった。東芝が２０２７年度中に人工知能（ＡＩ）データセンター向けのハードディスクドライブ（ＨＤＤ）の生産能力を倍増すると日経新聞が報じたことが材料となった。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．６７対１の比率で上回ったほか、ナスダックでも１．３４対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１６９億３０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億８０００万株。

items.body:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル、対ユーロで4週連続高へ　雇用統計受け上昇一服
10/3 6:16 配信

2025年5月4日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

［ニューヨーク　２日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが対ユーロで４週連続で上昇する見通し。ユーロ圏債の売りを背景に米債利回りが上昇しているほか、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が引き続きタカ派的な金融政策スタンスを維持するとの期待がドルを支援している。

ただ、２日発表された米雇用統計を受け、ドルは最近の上昇分を一部削った。９月の雇用統計では、非農業部門雇用者数が２万９０００人増で、前月から伸びが鈍化し市場予想を下回った。失業率は４．２％で、前月の４．１％から上昇した。

ノムラのＧ１０為替戦略責任者ドミニク・バニング氏は、雇用統計が全体として「ゴルディロックス（適温）」状態を示唆したと指摘。「経済活動は引き続きかなり堅調だが、大きなインフレ圧力を生み出していない」と述べた。その上で、市場が織り込む米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ見通しを大きく変える可能性は低いとしつつも、「１０月の追加利上げを巡るテールリスクを幾分後退させる効果はあるだろう」と述べた。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場はＦＲＢが８６％の確率で１０月に金利を据え置くと見込んでいる。１週間前は３６％だった。

終盤の取引で、ユーロ／ドルは０．１３％高の１．１２５８０ドル。ただ、ユーロは週間では４週連続での下げとなる見通しで、これは２０２５年５月半ば以来最長となる。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１％安の１０１．８８。ただ、週足では３週連続で上昇する見込み。

ドル／円は０．１５％安の１５７．８１円。ただ、ドルは週間で３週連続の上昇となる見通し。

ドル／スイスフランも０．３％安の０．８２８５フラン。

また、ユーロ圏金融・債券市場では、財政問題の悪化とインフレ高進を巡る懸念から、仏１０年債利回りが約２５年ぶりに５％近辺まで上昇する場面があった。

ユーロは対スイスフランで０．１５％安の０．９３２７フラン、対円では横ばいの１７７．６７円となった。週間ベースでは、ユーロはスイスフラン、円双方に対し下落する見通し。

ＮＹ市場サマリー（2日）利回り反転上昇、株続伸　ドル対ユーロで4週連続高へ
10/3 6:15 配信

＜為替＞　ドルが対ユーロで４週連続で上昇する見通し。ユーロ圏債の売りを背景に米債利回りが上昇しているほか、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が引き続きタカ派的な金融政策スタンスを維持するとの期待がドルを支援している。

ただ、２日発表された米雇用統計を受け、ドルは最近の上昇分を一部削った。９月の雇用統計では、非農業部門雇用者数が２万９０００人増で、前月から伸びが鈍化し市場予想を下回った。失業率は４．２％で、前月の４．１％から上昇した。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場はＦＲＢが８６％の確率で１０月に金利を据え置くと見込んでいる。１週間前は３６％だった。

終盤の取引で、ユーロ／ドルは０．１３％高の１．１２５８０ドル。ただ、ユーロは週間では４週連続での下げとなる見通しで、これは２０２５年５月半ば以来最長となる。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１％安の１０１．８８。ただ、週足では３週連続で上昇する見込み。

ドル／円は０．１５％安の１５７．８１円。ただ、ドルは週間で３週連続の上昇となる見通し。

ドル／スイスフランも０．３％安の０．８２８５フラン。

また、ユーロ圏金融・債券市場では、財政問題の悪化とインフレ高進を巡る懸念から、仏１０年債利回りが約２５年ぶりに５％近辺まで上昇する場面があった。

ユーロは対スイスフランで０．１５％安の０．９３２７フラン、対円では横ばいの１７７．６７円となった。週間ベースでは、ユーロはスイスフラン、円双方に対し下落する見通し。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　朝方発表された９月の雇用統計を受け国債が買われ、利回りが低下したものの、雇用統計の消化が進むにつれ売りが再燃し、利回りは上昇に転じた。市場関係者は、インフレ懸念や国債の大量発行など、債券市場を圧迫する複数の要因が改めて意識されたとしている。    労働省が発表した９月の雇用統計は非農業部門雇用者数が２万９０００人増と、伸びは前月から鈍化。失業率は４．２％と、前月の４．１％から上昇した。これを受け米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による追加利上げ観測が後退し、今月２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で金利据え置きが決定される確率は約８０％と、雇用統計発表前の７４％から上昇した。年内最後となる１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣで追加利上げが決定される確率は約８６％となっている。    雇用統計発表を受け当初は国債が全面的に買われたものの、その後は売りが再燃した。    終盤の取引で、１０年債利回りは４．７２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．２８１％。一時は５．１５７０％まで低下し、約１週間ぶりの低水準を付けていた。    ３０年債利回りは２．９１ｂｐ上昇の５．６３２１％。一時は５．５５２３％まで低下していた。    ２年債利回りは３．９８ｂｐ上昇の４．８２７％。一時４．６９３４％まで低下し、約２週間ぶりの低水準を付けていた。    ２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は４５．２ｂｐと、前日終盤からやや拡大した。    週間ベースでは１０年債利回りが１０ｂｐ、３０年債利回りが１３．２ｂｐ、それぞれ上昇。２年債利回りは３．３ｂｐ低下し、週間ベースで８月第２週以来初めて低下した。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　続伸して取引を終えた。この日発表された雇用統計の内容を受け、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による今月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ観測が後退した。    米労働省労働統計局が発表した９月の雇用統計によると、非農業部門雇用者数は２万９０００人増で、前月から伸びが鈍化し市場予想を下回った。過去２カ月分も大幅に下方改定された。失業率は４．２％で、前月の４．１％から上昇した。    これを受け、ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが１０月のＦＯＭＣで少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）利上げするとの観測は２２．７％と、前日の２４．４％、１週間前の６４．２％から低下した。     利上げ観測の後退を受け、金利に敏感な銘柄が買われた。Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の不動産セクターは０．４％高、中小型株で構成するラッセル２０００指数は０．９％高と、１日としては過去１カ月で最大の上昇率となった。    大型株も相場をけん引し、エヌビディアは１．３％高、 テスラは４．７％高と、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種を大きく押し上げた。テスラの上昇を受けＳ＆Ｐの一般消費財セクターは１．４％ 高と、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種のうち最も高いパフォーマンスとなった。    スポーツ用品大手ナイキは３．６％安。同社は１日、２０２７会計年度売上高が１桁台後半の減少率になるとの見通しを示したほか、追加の人員削減や世界事業の再編を含む新たな経営改善策を発表した。    データ記憶装置メーカーの株価も下落。ウエスタン・デジタルとシーゲイト・テクノロジーはいずれも約１０％急落し、Ｓ＆Ｐの情報技術セクターで下落率トップとなった。東芝が２０２７年度中に人工知能（ＡＩ）データセンター向けのハードディスクドライブ（ＨＤＤ）の生産能力を倍増すると日経新聞が報じたことが材料となった。    ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．６７対１の比率で上回ったほか、ナスダックでも１．３４対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。    米取引所の合算出来高は１６９億３０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億８０００万株。 

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　米雇用統計で９月の雇用増加が予想を大きく下回ったことを受け、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ観測が後退し、金相場は一時上昇したものの、ドル高と米長期金利の上昇が重しとなり、反落した。中心限月の清算値は１オンス＝４１６２．３０ドルで、前日比１％安。金現物は０．９％安の４１４０．０６ドルとなり、週間では３．４％安となった。

米労働省労働統計局が２日発表した９月の雇用統計によると、非農業部門雇用者数は２万９０００人増で、前月から伸びが鈍化し市場予想を下回った。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が今月の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で追加利上げに踏み切る可能性はほぼなくなったとみられる。ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによれば今月の利上げ確率は２２％と、週初の７０％から大きく低下した。アナリストは、ＦＲＢがインフレ抑制を優先する姿勢を維持する中、今後の金相場は米労働市場の動向次第との見方を示している。 

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　反落して取引を終えた。欧州首脳が、価格引き下げに向けてディーゼル燃料（軽油）の備蓄を放出するよう求めていた米国の要請に応じることで合意した。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．０６ドル（０．０６％）安の１バレル＝１０２．２５ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．７６ドル（１．９０％）安の１バレル＝９１．１１ドル。     主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は２日の首脳共同声明で、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）を通じてディーゼル燃料などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。Ｇ７の発表に先立ち、トランプ米大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で「欧州は大量に備蓄しているディーゼルを大規模に放出することに合意した。手続きは直ちに開始される」と表明していた。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

items.body:
欧州市場サマリー（2日）
10/3 3:51 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

反発して取引を終えた。今週は長期金利の上昇が相場の重しとなり、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間ベースで２．１８％安だった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．２１％高、週間では０．２８％下落した。

米雇用統計が市場予想を下回る内容で、米利上げ観測がいくぶん後退した。欧州で軽油や原油の追加放出を巡って協議されていると伝わり、エネルギー供給ひっ迫への警戒感も和らいだ。

前日に２００７年以来の高水準を付けた英１０年債利回りは上昇が一服。ＦＴＳＥ３５０種住宅建設株指数は０．０７％高と反発した。銀行株指数は０．６１％高となったものの、週間では４．６３％下落。

オンライン金融取引のＩＧグループは前日比２２．６％安。市場環境の悪化を要因として売上高見通しを引き下げたことが売り材料視された。同業のプラス５００は５．２％、ＣＭＣマーケッツは４．０％、それぞれ下落した。

好調な業績見通しを示した資源大手グレンコアは３．０％高。パブ経営のＪＤウェザースプーンは１２．５％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

反発して取引を終えた。原油高や長期金利上昇が一服したことで投資家心理が改善し、買い注文が優勢だった。米雇用統計が市場予想を下回る内容で、米利上げ観測がいくぶん後退した。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは１．１４％安と反落した。

テクノロジー株指数は前日比２．６４％高。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への期待感から半導体関連銘柄を物色する動きが目立った。ドイツのインフィニオン・テクノロジーズは８．８％、アイクストロンは７．６％、フランスのソイテックは７．７％、いずれも上昇した。

銀行株指数は０．１４％高。週間では４．８６％安だった。売上高見通しを引き下げたオンライン金融取引のＩＧグループは前日比２２．６％安。自社株買い計画を発表したスイスのプライベートバンク大手ジュリアス・ベアは２．０％高。

９月のユーロ圏消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）速報値は前年同月比の伸び率が拡大し、市場予想を上回った。今後数カ月でさらに上昇すると見られている。ＬＳＥＧによると、市場では１２月に欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が追加利上げするとの見方が８割超まで強まっている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス１０年債利回りが約２５年ぶりに５％近辺まで上昇する場面があった。終盤は９ｂｐ低下の４．８４４％。今週は１２ｂｐ上昇した。

今週は、財政問題の悪化とインフレ高進を巡る懸念からフランスの利回りが急上昇する一方、投資家がドイツ国債やオランダ国債などの安全資産に殺到するなど、波乱の１週間だった。２日の取引もボラティリティーの高い状況が続き、特にインフレや金利の予想に敏感な短期債で値動きが荒かった。

指標となる１０年物独連邦債の利回りは一時１３．７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下した。終盤は６ｂｐ低下の３．４５６％で、週間では１７ｂｐの低下となる見通し。

これにより、仏独の利回り格差は約１４０ｂｐとなった。一時１６０ｂｐ近くに急拡大し、２０１１年末以来の高水準となった。

独２年債利回りは終盤に横ばいの３．０５％。日中は２．９４３％から３．０６３％のレンジで推移した。

一方、仏２年債利回りは約４ｂｐ上昇の３．７３％で、一時は３．８４％まで上昇した。伊２年債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．５４７％。

今週は、独２年債利回りが０．２５％ポイント近く低下した一方、仏２年債利回りは１４ｂｐ近く上昇した。

ＤＺバンクのアナリスト、レネ・アルブレヒト氏は「質への逃避」を指摘し、「安全資産への需要が高まっている」と述べた。

伊１０年債利回りは１１ｂｐ低下の４．６０９％となったが、週間では６ｂｐ上昇した。

items.summary: [２日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は２日、９月の雇用統計で労働市場が安定していることが示され...
items.body:
ＦＲＢ、利上げ・据え置きとも選択肢　物価対応が優先課題＝シカゴ連銀総裁
10/3 2:44 配信

８月２７日撮影　 REUTERS/Ann Saphir

[２日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は２日、９月の雇用統計で労働市場が安定していることが示されたとし、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）にとってインフレへの対応が重要な課題になっていると述べた。

グールズビー氏はＦＯＸビジネス・ネットワークの番組「ザ・ビッグ・マネー」で、ＦＲＢは今月の会合で追加利上げを決定すべきか、それとも利上げを見送るべきかとの質問に対し、利上げと据え置きのいずれについても「なお十分に検討の余地がある」とし、「インフレ率が目標とする２％に向けて再び低下していることを示す証拠がまとまるか見極めたい」と語った。

ＦＲＢは９月１５─１６日に開いたＦＯＭＣで０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来３年２カ月ぶりで、決定は全会一致だった。１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣで追加利上げが決定されるとの観測は後退している。

グールズビー総裁は今年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持っていない。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [ローマ ２日 ロイター] - イタリアのジョルジェッティ経済・財務相は２日、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁が...
items.body:
ＥＣＢ総裁の早期退任観測、明確化必要　伊に後任候補なし＝伊経済相
10/3 2:28 配信

ラガルドECB総裁。7月23日、フランクフルトで撮影。REUTERS/Heiko Becker/File Photo

[ローマ ２日 ロイター] - イタリアのジョルジェッティ経済・財務相は２日、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁が任期途中で辞任する可能性があるといううわさについて、事実関係を明確にする必要があるとの認識を示した。

ジョルジェッティ財務相は「ラガルド総裁が何を考えているのか私には分からないが、この件を明確にしておくことは重要だと考える」と述べた。

また、イタリアは現時点でＥＣＢ総裁の後任候補として推薦する人材はいないと述べた。

ラガルド総裁を巡っては、２０２７年のフランス大統領選への出馬を目指し、ＥＣＢ総裁を任期途中で辞任するとの観測が浮上していた。これに対しラガルド総裁は今週、仏大統領選への出馬は「全く良い考えではない」と述べ、仮にＥＣＢ総裁職を退任するとしても、任期満了より数カ月早い時期にとどまるとの考えを示した。
